name: media-log
description: Media Log plugin for Obsidian — save links as durable Markdown media items and browse them as a gallery.

scripts.check: node --check src/main.js && node --check src/browse.js && node --check src/sifi.js && node scripts/smoke-test.cjs && node --test scripts/browse-test.cjs && node scripts/sifi-smoke.cjs && node scripts/release-check.mjs
scripts.release:check: npm run build && npm run check && git diff --exit-code -- main.js
